description: Backend orchestration, endpoints and hook points. Adds the override-aware persistence orchestrator (with the seoAuto master kill-switch gate), the DB-row batch queue + 15-min cron audit job (mirroring video/queue.ts + reminderJob/videoScheduler, no new queue dependency), the feature flags, the invalidateSeoCaches helper + category sitemap lastmod, the staff-gated /api/admin/seo-auto/* router + rate limiter, and wires the auto-generation hooks into POST /admin/products, POST /admin/categories, dataImport.runImport, the two category OG routes, and server.ts. Depends on FEAT-001's modules. Leaves api-node type-checking clean and all existing commerce routes/pages behaviorally unchanged (hooks are fire-and-forget, columns ADD-only).
steps: Create api-node/src/seo/persist.ts: a `loadStoredFeatures()` helper reading config.features and `mergeFeatures(...)`; `runProductSeo(productId, { actor })` and `runCategorySeo(id, { actor })` that BEGIN with the kill-switch gate `const features = mergeFeatures(await loadStoredFeatures()); if (!features.seoAuto) return;`. `persistProductSeo`/`persistCategorySeo`: load the current row; always store the fresh generated payload in seo_auto_json; for each engine-generated effective field (seo_title, seo_description, seo_keywords, seo_slug — og_image EXCLUDED) write only when seo_overrides[field] !== true (else log skip_override); compute seo_score/seo_problems/seo_generated_at/seo_source_hash. Do the effective-column writes + score/flags inside ONE awaited `prisma.$transaction` keyed by id (the atomic publish); write seo_audit_log rows AFTER the transaction commits, fire-and-forget. Race-safety: recompute seo_source_hash just before write and requeue (skip) if it moved mid-flight.

Create api-node/src/services/seoQueue.ts mirroring api-node/src/video/queue.ts: `enqueueSeoJob(type, scope, createdBy)` inserting a seo_jobs row (type in optimize_all|optimize_selected|optimize_category|audit) and calling kick(); a single module-level `running` guard so only one job runs at a time; `kick()` processes queued jobs oldest-first, iterating entities in batches of ~50 with an `await` yield between batches and writing progress/processed/updated/skipped/failed each batch; the idempotent skip = unchanged seo_source_hash AND seo_score >= ATTENTION_THRESHOLD (import the constant from completeness.ts) AND no seo_problems; per-entity failure retried up to 2x with backoff, recorded in a bounded `log` + failed count without aborting the job; before any writing run snapshot affected rows' seo_* columns into seo_backups and set seo_jobs.backup_id; `recoverSeoQueue()` marks interrupted `running` jobs failed with a clear message and resumes queued jobs; a `rollbackJob(jobId?)` restoring the most recent backup for the scope in a transaction + invalidateSeoCaches().

Create api-node/src/services/seoAuditJob.ts mirroring reminderJob.ts/videoScheduler.ts: `runAuditSweep()` that BEGINS with the same seoAuto gate, finds products/categories whose freshly computed sourceHash != stored seo_source_hash OR whose seo_generated_at is null, enqueues a bounded (~200/sweep) changed-only `audit` job (idempotent: skip if an audit/optimize_all job is already queued/running), busts the SEO caches via invalidateSeoCaches() when anything published, and recomputes a small cached dashboard aggregate snapshot. `startSeoAuditJob()` calls `recoverSeoQueue()` as its FIRST line, then `cron.schedule('*/15 * * * *', runAuditSweep)` and a flagged-no-op daily `cron.schedule('0 3 * * *', ...)` crawler stub.

Edit api-node/src/utils/features.ts: add to FEATURE_KEYS and DEFAULT_FEATURES the keys `seoAuto: true` (master; absent = ON) and `seoAutoGsc: false, seoAutoGa4: false, seoAutoGbp: false, seoAutoCrawler: false` (PHASE-2; inverted convention — default OFF so automation stays dark until explicitly enabled). Add a comment documenting the inverted convention. Do NOT change mergeFeatures logic.

Edit api-node/src/routes/seo.ts: `export function invalidateSeoCaches() { cache.delete('sitemap'); cache.delete('robots'); }` (clear BOTH keys). Change the sitemap category select from `{ slug: true }` to `{ slug: true, seo_generated_at: true }` and call `urlEntry(`${SITE_ORIGIN}/category/${c.slug}`, c.seo_generated_at)` (urlEntry already omits <lastmod> when null).
Create api-node/src/utils/rateLimit.ts: a small in-memory per-user token bucket (e.g. 10/min) usable as middleware; no external dependency.

Create api-node/src/routes/seo-admin.ts: a Router where EVERY route additionally applies `requireStaff('settings')`, bodies validated with zod in the existing style, and optimize/audit/rollback rate-limited via utils/rateLimit.ts. Routes (design section 7): GET /dashboard, GET /products, POST /optimize ({ mode:'all'|'selected'|'category', productIds?, category? }), POST /audit, GET /jobs/:id, GET /jobs, POST /rollback, POST /override ({ entityType, id, field, value }), POST /reset-auto, GET /integrations, POST /integrations/:provider. Every counter comes from real queries (dedupe.ts/completeness.ts/seo_jobs/seo_audit_log/seo_integrations); never return secrets; PHASE-2 metrics returned as explicit unavailable/not-connected. Validation per design section 10 (optimize.category slug ^[a-z0-9-]{1,120}$, productIds int[] <=1000, etc.).

Edit api-node/src/routes/admin.ts POST /products (keep requireStaff('products')): for each admin-supplied SEO field set seo_overrides[field] = true ONLY when the parsed value is a non-empty string (empty/absent clears the flag — read req.body.product[field] before the `|| null` coercion to detect an explicit clear), persist the overrides JSON, then call `void runProductSeo(product.id, { actor: username })` fire-and-forget AFTER the create/update (never block or fail the product save on an SEO error).

Edit api-node/src/routes/admin.ts POST /categories (keep requireStaff('categories')): same non-empty-string override rule for category SEO fields; fire-and-forget `runCategorySeo` on add/update; on slug rename reuse the existing `tx.product.updateMany` block and reprocess the reassigned products.

Edit api-node/src/routes/og.ts: ADD `GET /api/og/category/:slug` (validate slug `^[a-z0-9-]{1,120}$`, 404 otherwise; shareHtml with title/desc/keywords/canonical/robots/OG/Twitter + buildBreadcrumbJsonLd + buildItemListJsonLd for the product list; og:image = `${API_ORIGIN}/og/image/category/:slug`) and `GET /api/og/image/category/:slug` (same slug bound; reuse getOrRenderOg with the category og_image override if set, else a logo-or-sample-product card like /image/page/:slug). Leave the existing product JSON-LD image argument unchanged.

Edit api-node/src/services/dataImport.ts runImport: after the upsert/import completes, enqueue ONE changed-only `audit` seo_jobs row (not optimize_all), idempotent (skip if an audit/optimize_all job is already queued/running); the enqueue is itself gated by seoAuto (skip when off). Do NOT run generation inline per row.

Edit api-node/src/server.ts: import the seo-admin router and startSeoAuditJob; mount `app.use('/api/admin/seo-auto', requireAuth, seoAdminRouter)` BEFORE the generic `app.use('/api/admin', adminRouter)` (specific path first, matching the adminDataRouter ordering); call `startSeoAuditJob()` in the app.listen callback beside startReminderJob()/startVideoScheduler(). Add nothing else to server.ts (recovery runs inside startSeoAuditJob).
acceptance_criteria: Running `npx tsc --noEmit` in api-node exits 0 with persist/seoQueue/seoAuditJob/seo-admin/rateLimit present and wired.
runProductSeo/runCategorySeo/runAuditSweep all early-return when seoAuto is off (single mergeFeatures(config.features) gate).

The queue runs one job at a time, snapshots to seo_backups before writing, retries per-entity up to 2x, and skips entities that are unchanged AND >= ATTENTION_THRESHOLD AND problem-free using the same constant the dashboard uses.

Every /api/admin/seo-auto/* route is behind requireAuth + requireStaff('settings'); POST /products and POST /categories keep their existing products/categories permissions and their hooks are fire-and-forget.
server.ts mounts /api/admin/seo-auto before /api/admin and starts the audit job in the listen callback; no existing route/mount behavior changed.
No endpoint returns secrets; PHASE-2 integration metrics surface as not-connected/unavailable; no fabricated data is written.
verification: Run `npx tsc --noEmit` in api-node — must exit 0.
Grep-review server.ts to confirm the seo-auto mount precedes the generic /api/admin mount and startSeoAuditJob() is called once in the listen callback.
findings:
FEAT-002 landed. VERIFICATION: `npx tsc --noEmit` in api-node exits 0 (no schema.prisma change → no prisma generate needed; FEAT-001's client already has SeoJob/SeoAuditLog/SeoBackup/SeoIntegration). server.ts mounts `app.use('/api/admin/seo-auto', requireAuth, seoAdminRouter)` (line 58) BEFORE `app.use('/api/admin', adminRouter)` (line 59) and after adminDataRouter; `startSeoAuditJob()` is called once in the app.listen callback beside startReminderJob()/startVideoScheduler().

NEW FILES: src/seo/persist.ts, src/services/seoQueue.ts, src/services/seoAuditJob.ts, src/routes/seo-admin.ts, src/utils/rateLimit.ts. EDITED: src/utils/features.ts, src/routes/seo.ts, src/routes/og.ts, src/routes/admin.ts, src/services/dataImport.ts, src/server.ts.

EXPORTS FOR FEAT-003:

src/seo/persist.ts: `loadStoredFeatures(): Promise<unknown>`, `loadFeatures(): Promise<Features>`, `loadSeoConfig(): Promise<SeoConfig>`, `RunOptions { actor?: string; jobId?: number|null }`, `PersistOutcome { status: 'published'|'skipped'|'skipped_off'|'not_found'|'race'; score?; problems?; sourceHash?; wrote? }`, `persistProductSeo(productId, cfg, opts?)`, `persistCategorySeo(categoryId, cfg, opts?)`, `runProductSeo(productId, opts?)`, `runCategorySeo(categoryId, opts?)`. runProduct/CategorySeo begin with the single `mergeFeatures(loadStoredFeatures())` seoAuto gate → return {status:'skipped_off'} when off. Audit rows written AFTER the awaited $transaction, fire-and-forget. og_image EXCLUDED from the engine-written effective fields (title/description/keywords/slug for products; title/description/keywords/intro for categories). Race-safety: seo_source_hash re-checked inside the transaction; moved → {status:'race'} (requeued).

src/services/seoQueue.ts: `SeoJobType = 'optimize_all'|'optimize_selected'|'optimize_category'|'audit'`, `SeoJobScope { productIds?: number[]; category?: string }`, `SeoJobView` (id,type,status,scope,total,processed,updated,skipped,failed,progress,backupId,log[],error,createdBy,createdAt,startedAt,finishedAt). Fns: `enqueueSeoJob(type, scope|null, createdBy): Promise<number>` (inserts row + kick()), `kick()`, `getJob(id): Promise<SeoJobView|null>`, `recentJobs(limit=20)`, `hasPendingCatalogueJob(): Promise<boolean>` (audit/optimize_all queued|running), `rollbackJob(jobId?): Promise<{restored:number; backupId:number|null}>`, `recoverSeoQueue()`. Single module-level `running` guard (one job at a time). Batches of 50 with `await sleep(0)` yield. Idempotent skip imports ATTENTION_THRESHOLD from completeness.ts: skip when unchanged hash AND score>=threshold AND no problems. Per-entity retry up to 2x. Snapshots affected rows into seo_backups (entity_type='mixed', snapshot=JSON array of {entityType,id,columns}) + sets seo_jobs.backup_id before writing. invalidateSeoCaches() on publish.

src/services/seoAuditJob.ts: `runAuditSweep(): Promise<{enqueued; jobId?; changed?}>` (seoAuto-gated; de-dupes via hasPendingCatalogueJob; counts stale by hash/null generated_at, cap 200; enqueues ONE changed-only 'audit' job), `startSeoAuditJob()` (recoverSeoQueue() FIRST line, then cron '*/15 * * * *' runAuditSweep + a flagged-no-op daily '0 3 * * *' crawler stub gated by seoAutoCrawler).

src/utils/features.ts: added FEATURE_KEYS/DEFAULT_FEATURES: `seoAuto: true` (master, absent=ON) + PHASE-2 `seoAutoGsc/seoAutoGa4/seoAutoGbp/seoAutoCrawler: false` (inverted convention commented). mergeFeatures UNCHANGED.

src/routes/seo.ts: `invalidateSeoCaches()` exported (clears 'sitemap' AND 'robots'). Sitemap category select now `{ slug, seo_generated_at }` → `urlEntry(.../category/${c.slug}, c.seo_generated_at)`.

src/utils/rateLimit.ts: `rateLimit({ limit?=10, windowMs?=60000, bucket? })` → Express middleware, per-user (req.user.sub, fallback req.ip) in-memory token bucket, 429 + Retry-After when exhausted.

/api/admin/seo-auto/* ROUTE LIST (all behind requireAuth [server.ts] + requireStaff('settings') [router.use]; success envelope { success:true, ...payload }; errors { success:false, message }):
- GET  /dashboard → { counters:{ products:{total,optimized,needingAttention,withProblems,missingMetadata}, categories:{total,optimized,needingAttention}, duplicates:{titles,descriptions,slugs}, brokenLinks:'unavailable', coreWebVitals:'unavailable', organicPerformance:'not_connected' }, attentionThreshold:80, jobs:SeoJobView[], integrations:IntegrationStatus[], recentChanges:[{entityType,entityId,action,field,reason,actor,at}] }
- GET  /products?filter=all|needs-attention|duplicate&cursor=<int>&limit=<1..100> → { products:[{id,name,title,slug,score,problems[],needsAttention,generatedAt}], nextCursor:number|null } (keyset by id)
- POST /optimize (rate-limited) body { mode:'all'|'selected'|'category', productIds?:int[]<=1000, category?:^[a-z0-9-]{1,120}$ } → { jobId } (422 on bad body; 404 if category slug not found)
- POST /audit (rate-limited) → { jobId }
- GET  /jobs/:id → { job:SeoJobView } (404 if missing)
- GET  /jobs → { jobs:SeoJobView[] }
- POST /rollback (rate-limited) body { jobId?:int } → { restored, backupId } (409 { message:'No backup to roll back' } when none)
- POST /override body { entityType:'product'|'category', id:int|slug, field:string, value:boolean } → { entityType, id, field, value }. Allowed fields: product=title|description|keywords|slug; category=title|description|keywords|intro. value=true sets seo_overrides[field]=true; value=false deletes the key.
- POST /reset-auto (rate-limited) body { entityType, id:int|slug, field? } → { entityType, id, cleared:field|'all' }; clears override(s) then fires runProductSeo/runCategorySeo (gated).
- GET  /integrations → { integrations:[gsc,ga4,gbp] } (IntegrationStatus; no secrets)
- POST /integrations/:provider (provider gsc|ga4|gbp, 404 otherwise) body { action:'connect'|'disconnect', accountRef?:string<=190 } → { status:IntegrationStatus }

EDITED COMMERCE ROUTES (permissions UNCHANGED): POST /api/admin/products keeps requireStaff('products'); POST /api/admin/categories keeps requireStaff('categories'). Both read the RAW req.body before productSchema/categorySchema `|| null` coercion and set seo_overrides[field]=true ONLY for a non-empty string (helper seoOverrideFlags) — product fields title/description/keywords; category fields title/description/keywords/intro. Both fire-and-forget runProductSeo/runCategorySeo AFTER create/update (never block/fail the save). Category slug rename reuses the existing tx.product.updateMany block, then reprocesses the reassigned products.

OG: GET /api/og/category/:slug (slug ^[a-z0-9-]{1,120}$, hidden=0, 404 otherwise) → shareHtml with effective seo_title/description/keywords + canonical/robots/OG/Twitter + buildBreadcrumbJsonLd + buildItemListJsonLd(member products, max 50); og:image = ${API_ORIGIN}/og/image/category/:slug. GET /api/og/image/category/:slug → getOrRenderOg('category-<slug>', { category og_image||image override, else logo card }). Product JSON-LD image argument left UNCHANGED.

DEVIATIONS FROM DESIGN: (1) persist.ts loads validation dup-context from live queries (existingTitles carries desc dupes keyed 'desc:<lower>' per FEAT-001's validate.ts contract) and merges checkDbTruth problems (AVAILABILITY/PRICE) computed from the DB-derived offer, as FEAT-001 specified. (2) seo_backups rows use entity_type='mixed' with a JSON array snapshot covering both products and categories affected by the job (schema entity_type is VARCHAR(16); 'mixed' fits). (3) No schema.prisma edit in FEAT-002 (all tables/columns already added in FEAT-001), so prisma generate was not re-run. No behavioral deviation from the approved design otherwise.
